title: Rate-Limited Web Page Fetcher
scenario: Build an isolated, rate-limited web page fetcher for a documentation indexing service. Each rate limiter and crawler instance must own its own quota, deduplication, and cancellation state while bounding concurrency, preserving error causes, and cleaning up abort listeners.

milestones.title: Contracts, Errors & URL Normalization
milestones.goal: Define typed crawler contracts, CrawlerError with preserved cause, and pure normalizeUrls deduplication without input mutation.

milestones.title: Closure-Scoped Rate Limiter
milestones.goal: Implement createRateLimiter with strictly instance-owned sliding-window state and injectable clock/sleep.

milestones.title: Bounded Concurrent Page Crawler
milestones.goal: Implement createPageCrawler with per-crawl deduplication, bounded concurrency, rate limiter integration, and error preservation.

milestones.title: AbortSignal Cancellation & Listener Cleanup
milestones.goal: Cancel queued work cleanly on AbortSignal, preserve started fetch outcomes, and detach abort listeners after settlement.

review.note: No leaks, distinct realistic domain, valid PRG-T01-C01 units/traps, clean _reference Layer 3, and package.json check:hidden now passes all 8 hidden tests with LAB_SRC_DIR=../src.
